annotations.title: Add a hook to a clip

description: Add a hook, big bold text over the first seconds that stops the scroll, to one finished clip and re-render it. Pass text to use your own (max 80 characters, 3-7 words reads best) or omit it and Katto's AI writes one from the clip in its language. position: top (default) or center; duration: 1-10 s (default 4). Styled like the editor's AI Hook (white, boxed, pop-in). Does NOT use video quota; the original clip is kept. Not idempotent: each call starts a new render, and a re-render starts from the original clip, so calling it again replaces the hook rather than stacking two. Returns { rerender_id, hook_text, generated, status_url }; poll katto_get_rerender for the new clip_url.

duration.description: How many seconds the hook stays on screen, 1-10 (default 4).

position.description: Where the hook sits on the frame (default top).

text.description: The hook to display (max 80 characters; 3-7 words reads best). Omit to let Katto write one from the clip.

name: katto_add_hook
